newsitem.title: USA: Venture says it in deal with Kimco.
newsitem.headline: Venture says it in deal with Kimco.

text.p: Venture Stores Inc said Thursday it made a deal with Kimco Realty Corp valued at about $135 million involving the sale of various Venture real estate assets.
The transaction will provide Venture with about $75 million in cash to finance continuation of its repositioning as a family value retailer.
"It also includes the assumption by Kimco of approximately $60 million of existing mortgage debt on certain properties," Venture said.
Under the deal, Venture will lease back some of the properties, which include existing stores, vacant land and other properties.

"With the cash from the real estate transaction and our other financial initiatives, Venture will have more than adequate funding available as we enter our peak borrowing season," Venture chairman and chief executive officer Robert Wildrick said in a news release.
Venture shares were up 1/8 at 2-3/8 and Kimco shares were up 5/16 at 35 Thursday.
